revisions.reason: Reviewed 20261127 midiOut TinySynth output gain only: initial setAudioContext routes to the existing per-output master; after reset or pooled reuse, reconnect only the actual synth compressor when its destination differs from the current master. Fixed synth master gain, voice/channel state, timer initialization, MCI sequence bus, oscillator fallback and desktop mixer buses retained. Public createHostImports regression uses bundled TinySynth and the existing richer FakeAudioContext for node identities/parameters, with zero-before-note, later volume changes, separate handles/device/MAPPER defaults, reset and close/pool reuse. No callback producer, guest reentry, notification, scheduling or memory-transport change; existing callback ownership remains pending. No measured sound or Windows stereo balance claim. Run 20261127-midi-output-gain-repair-root.
